model.description: Gemini model id. Free text accepted for preview/custom models. See ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models for the full list. Left blank until live discovery selects the cheapest available model.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level. Maps to thinkingLevel (Gemini 3) or thinkingBudget tokens (Gemini 2.5). 'disabled' turns off thinking.

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: Request a JSON-constrained reply via Gemini's native structured outputs: responseSchema for fixed-shape replies, plain JSON mode for map-shaped ones Gemini's schema dialect cannot express. Greatly reduces 'malformed JSON from provider' errors. On by default — turn off only if a custom endpoint or preview model rejects structured output.
